Bind-pose mismatch on bone_0, bone_22: the mesh was modelled in a different pose than the skeleton assumes. Weight smoothing and triangle cuts only mask it. For a recognised humanoid run repair-skin --rebuild-limbs (rebuilds the legs in the skeleton's pose); otherwise rebuild the limbs in your DCC tool or regenerate and re-rig the model in the pose the skeleton assumes.
Still failing after smooth-bridges: SKIN_STRETCH, SKIN_BIND_MISMATCH. Cutting stretched triangles opens holes; prefer --rebuild-limbs or re-rigging.
Re-admit the repaired file with `aura3d assets add` (it gets a new hash); do not edit the manifest by hand.
